params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to posts with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Sparse fieldset — comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to items with particular parent IDs.

params.name: menu_order
params.description: Limit result set to posts with a specific menu_order value.

items.docs: Lists published pages. Nine at harvest time — Home, About Us, Our Science, Pipeline, News, Careers, Contact Us, Privacy Notices, Terms of Service.
